name: Digital Earth Australia Hotspots (Geoscience Australia)
short: Satellite fire hotspots over Australia, updated through the day. Free, no key, CC BY 4.0.
summary: Geoscience Australia's Digital Earth Australia Hotspots serves satellite-detected fire hotspots for Australia as a keyless WFS GeoServer: point detections with satellite and sensor (for example Himawari-9 AHI), acquisition time, fire power, confidence, temperature and Australian state, for the last three days and the full set. On 2026-11-08 the three-day layer returned GeoJSON whose newest detection was stamped 2026-11-08T03:00Z, minutes before the call.

tasks: fire hotspots near a place in Australia in the last three days
latest satellite pass times and hotspot count for an Australian state
fire radiative power and confidence of a hotspot

coverage.notes: Detections from geostationary and polar satellites over Australia; a hotspot is a heat signal, not a confirmed fire or its extent.

delivery.basis: Live GET 2026-11-08: newest detection start_dt 2026-11-08T03:00:00Z against a call at about 03:25Z.

latency.notes: Geostationary Himawari scans every 10 minutes; polar passes add detections several times a day.

freshness.typical_age: Minutes to an hour after satellite acquisition
freshness.notes: Geostationary Himawari scans every 10 minutes; polar passes add detections several times a day.

licensing.summary: The WFS capabilities state: (c) Commonwealth of Australia (Geoscience Australia) 2016, released under the Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International Licence. Fees: none. Attribute Geoscience Australia and link the licence. Hotspots are automated and can include false alarms. AI training is not specifically addressed beyond CC BY 4.0.

human.unknown: Not applicable: automated systems, not people.

application.unknown: No signing or attestation from source to API is documented.

camera.unknown: Not applicable: no imagery in this feed.

corroboration.unknown: Nothing documented independently confirms individual readings.

time.unknown: Satellite clock handling is not documented in the pages read.

location.method: Latitude and longitude from the satellite detection.
location.unknown: Geostationary pixel size limits location accuracy; an accuracy field is present.

content.method: Automated fire detection algorithm with a confidence value.
content.unknown: False detections occur; no ground confirmation.

auth.how_to_get: No key sent or needed in the calls made.

endpoints.notes: Layers incl. public:hotspots, public:hotspots_three_days and satellite pass layers.
Hotspots in the last three days as GeoJSON; add bbox or cql_filter to limit the area.

api.rate_limits: Not stated in the pages read.
api.notes: Standard OGC WFS 2.0.0 served by GeoServer.
